Hi Aileen — welcome, and great to hear. Appreciate the packet. Below is a consolidated checklist and what we need to complete vendor setup on our side.

1) Vendor details (please confirm): legal name, remit address, primary billing contact, and VAT/Tax ID.
2) Completed Redwood vendor setup form (attached) — this includes bank wiring instructions or KYC if needed.
3) W-9 (or local tax form) — we will attach ours for your records.
4) PO expectations: we accept your PO# in a PO-number field on invoices. Our system prefers one PO number per invoice but supports multiple PO references in the header.
5) Preferred line-item model: we recommend a single line per agreement line (subscription/tranche) with a short free-text description and a separate column for quantity, unit price, billing cadence, and start/end dates. This maps cleanly to our ERP and speeds processing.
6) Timeline: once vendor is added in our vendor master and we receive a signed vendor setup form + W-9, we can accept the first PO within 3 business days. Invoice payment terms will follow the SOW or PO (standard Net 30).

I attached the Redwood vendor setup form and our W-9. Lauren — added you to loop for any procurement-specific constraints (GL code, one-off payment flows, or pre-approved spend blocks).

Next steps: Aileen, can you return the completed vendor form and W-9 by EOD Mon May 3? I’ll push vendor setup as soon as I receive them. If you prefer a call, I’m available Thu afternoon.

Thanks,

Hi Aileen — quick procurement notes from our side to make sure there are no surprises: 

- PO issuance timeline: typical internal lead time is 3–5 business days after vendor is onboarded and vendor packet is complete. For first-time vendors we commonly target 5 business days to allow approvals.
- Line-item guidance: please provide one row per billable element. Required columns: description, qty, unit price, billing cadence (monthly/one-time/annual), start date, end date, currency, and any internal cost center/GL if you have it. Do NOT combine multiple unrelated services on a single line.
- Tax & remittance: include billing address and remit-to if different. If you invoice in a currency other than USD, note FX handling.
- Attach a sample CSV (I’ve included a template). If BluePeak prefers consolidated billing, note that in the CSV and include mapping to subscription IDs.
- Exceptions: if you need partial advance payment or deposit, flag that explicitly so we can request budget approval.

I’m attaching sample_po_lineitem.csv with an example. Karthik — please advise if there are any special billing approvals required for a multi-region account.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
